title: QIF v0.6.3 Diagram Comprehension Evidence
description: Harden authoring-template packages so diagrams require audience restatement evidence, misunderstanding handling, revision action, and governance when not understood.
validated_need: A diagram is not useful evidence unless the intended audience can understand and restate what it means.
intent: Make diagram communication success auditable without treating diagram presence or sample comprehension as universal proof.
context: v0.6.2 requires audience explanation contracts and diagrams. This slice adds comprehension evidence for those diagrams.
triage_note: Implementation completed; release outcome will be recorded in docs/aof-runtime-log.md if released.
